item.text: {"search_note":"I found no credible 2024 evidence of Sharif taking an affirmative, public action to protect independent media, restore blocked platforms, or shield journalists from PEMRA/political pressure. The best “positive” items are actually court interventions against government censorship, which are not the same as Sharif protecting media freedom. On balance, the year shows restriction and pressure, not protection.","evidence":[{"title":"Pakistan: Widening Crackdown on Dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/pakistan-widening-crackdown-dissent","summary":"HRW said authorities increased pressure on media, and journalists reported intimidation, harassment, and surveillance for perceived criticism of the government. This is strong evidence against protecting independent media or information access.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.5","4B.4","4B.3"]},{"title":"Pakistan election-day internet shutdown is a reckless attack on people’s rights","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-08","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/pakistan-election-day-internet-shutdown-is-a-reckless-attack-on-peoples-rights/","summary":"The election-day mobile and telecom shutdown blocked expression and information access during a politically sensitive period, creating a coercive information environment.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.2","4B.3","4B.5"]},{"title":"US urges Pakistan to lift internet shutdowns, social media restrictions","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-02-21","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/us-urges-pakistan-to-lift-internet-shutdowns-social-media-restrictions-3310177","summary":"The U.S. State Department condemned Pakistan’s shutdowns and social-media restrictions, including X/Twitter, and urged restoration of access. That is direct counterevidence to a tolerance-for-information-access reading.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.2","4B.3"]},{"title":"Pakistan: Civil Society Joint Statement Responding to Network Shutdowns and Platform Blocking","publisher":"Amnesty International / civil society joint statement","date":"2024-03-15","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/asa33/7834/2024/en/","summary":"Civil-society groups called for immediate restoration of X after the platform had been blocked since 17 February and linked the block to the election-day shutdown. This shows monitoring voices were being obstructed by state controls.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3","4B.2"]},{"title":"IHC restrains Pemra from taking action over court reporting","publisher":"Dawn","date":"2024-05-25","url":"https://www.dawn.com/news/1835528","summary":"The Islamabad High Court restrained PEMRA from adverse action over court reporting, after a PEMRA notification had barred tickers/headlines on court proceedings. This is the clearest counterpoint, but it reflects judicial pushback rather than a Sharif-led defense of media freedom.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.4"]},{"title":"Pakistan: Controversial Punjab Defamation Act Signed into Law","publisher":"Library of Congress","date":"2024-06-25 / 2024-06-26","url":"https://www.loc.gov/item/global-legal-monitor/2024-06-25/pakistan-controversial-punjab-defamation-act-signed-into-law","summary":"Punjab passed and signed into law a broad defamation act that critics said could be weaponized against critics and media, with government-run tribunals and platform-suspension powers. This is strong evidence against protecting independent media.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.5","4B.4","4B.2"]},{"title":"Pakistan report","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"2024","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128431.html","summary":"The report says journalists faced pressure to follow a predetermined narrative, PEMRA directives pushed coverage favoring military/diplomatic successes, journalists were discouraged from covering protests, and some were told to avoid PTI coverage before the election. This is direct evidence of state pressure on media content.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.5","4B.4","4B.3","4B.2"]},{"title":"Pakistan: The new Peaceful Assembly and Public Order Act threatens the right to protest","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-09","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/pakistan-the-new-peaceful-assembly-and-public-order-act-threatens-the-right-to-protest/","summary":"Although centered on protest, the law also tightened control over public communication around assemblies and reinforced a broader censorship/restriction climate. It supports the reading that the government did not protect open information flows.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3","4B.2"]},{"title":"SHC extends order to restrain Pemra from enforcing court reporting ban","publisher":"Dawn","date":"2024-06-08","url":"https://www.dawn.com/news/1838487","summary":"The Sindh High Court again restrained PEMRA from enforcing the court-reporting ban. Like the IHC order, this is a limited positive only because the judiciary blocked censorship, not because Sharif’s government refrained from it.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.4"]}]}
